mapper.sql: sku_id, product_id, spec_name, price, stock_available, stock_locked, low_stock_threshold, version, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku(sku_id, product_id, spec_name, price, stock_available, stock_locked, version, low_stock_threshold, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{productId}, #{specName}, #{price}, #{stockAvailable}, 0, 0, #{lowStockThreshold}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY spec_name
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET stock_available = #{stockAvailable}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE sku SET stock_locked = stock_locked + #{quantity}, stock_available = stock_available - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND stock_available >= #{quantity} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = sku.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' )

UPDATE sku SET stock_locked = stock_locked - #{quantity}, stock_available = stock_available + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND stock_locked >= #{quantity}
UPDATE sku SET stock_locked = stock_locked - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND stock_locked >= #{quantity}
UPDATE sku SET stock_available = stock_available + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sku SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sku SET low_stock_threshold = #{threshold}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id, s.product_id, p.title AS product_title, s.spec_name, s.stock_available, s.stock_locked, COALESCE(s.low_stock_threshold, #{globalThreshold}) AS threshold FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND (#{sellerId} IS NULL OR p.seller_id = #{sellerId}) AND s.stock_available < COALESCE(s.low_stock_threshold, #{globalThreshold}) ORDER BY s.stock_available ASC, s.updated_at ASC, s.sku_id
